brief: Identify missing or conflicting agreement terms, obtain a verified written explanation and preserve evidence for a later discrepancy.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Check before signing"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Revisa antes de firmar"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira antes de assinar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify missing or conflicting agreement terms, obtain a verified written explanation and preserve evidence for a later discrepancy.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: An agreement can create obligations beyond the advertisement. Make the costs, dates and conditions understandable before accepting.
instruction.misconception: Assuming a verbal promise overrides written conditions or that signing without understanding is necessary to compare an offer.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the stated quantities, dates and conditions; distinguish a modeled result from a guarantee.

en-US.line: An agreement can create obligations beyond the advertisement. Make the costs, dates and conditions understandable before accepting.

es-MX.line: Un acuerdo puede crear obligaciones más allá del anuncio. Aclara costos, fechas y condiciones antes de aceptar.

pt-BR.line: Um acordo pode criar obrigações além do anúncio. Entenda custos, datas e condições antes de aceitar.

en-US.line: The seller denies a fee listed in the agreement. Pause acceptance and request written clarification through verified support.

es-MX.line: El vendedor dice que no hay cargo, pero el acuerdo escrito incluye uno. Pausa la aceptación y pide aclaración escrita al soporte verificado.

en-US.line: Keep accepted terms, receipts and messages. They help explain discrepancies to the provider or local consumer authority.

es-MX.line: Guarda condiciones aceptadas, comprobantes y mensajes relevantes. Si un cargo difiere, ayudan a explicar el problema al proveedor o autoridad local.

pt-BR.line: Guarde condições aceitas, comprovantes e mensagens relevantes. Se uma cobrança divergir, ajudam a explicar o problema ao fornecedor ou autoridade local.
